opening.argument: The presentation is a seated interview examining Bitcoin market cycles, not a transaction or account-opening pitch. It asks whether Bitcoin's decline is expected and when recovery might occur, while describing the market as cyclical and bearish. The speaker remains long-term bullish, but that view is expressed as an outlook, alongside a forecast that recovery may not arrive until the first quarter of the following year. Discussion of gold is likewise personal: the speaker explains why it makes sense to continue holding it in a portfolio and says it will “likely outperform the S&P 500.” There is no required payment, signup, or investment, and viewers are expressly told to consult a licensed adviser and conduct their own research.
